incident.cause: Unsupported entity names in otherwise committed extraction artifacts caused the whole memory job to fail. Gaps in contiguous fact coverage exceeded the 16-event raw-tail window.

repair.unsupportedEntityCandidates: Review drafts with exact evidence; excluded from recall, observation and knowledge grants.
repair.affectedSourceFallback: Director-only raw episodes with canonical source evidence; no inferred world facts or character grants.
repair.evidenceIdentity: Shared deterministic IDs for new identical spans; existing span IDs reused.
repair.sourceAndDeletionFences: Retained; invalid source, deletion epoch or database failures remain terminal.
repair.normalAndRebuildPolicy: Same quarantine policy; factual cursor advances only after an atomic evidence-and-event-application commit.

liveRecovery.method: Sequential retries with new stable Workflow identities and unchanged source/deletion fences; existing validated extraction artifacts reused.
liveRecovery.administrativeDispatchRetry: One REST dispatch attempt received a string payload and stopped before any application mutation (Invalid owner). A fresh identity with an object payload completed. The OpenAPI params schema differed from runtime behavior.
liveRecovery.unrelatedHistoricalRebuild: An older output-truncation rebuild failure remains visible; not needed for current fact coverage and not replayed.

latestBlockedGeneration.method: Retried once with saved current model configuration, unchanged input and expected branch head, new attempt, and transactional guards.

validation.limitations: Deterministic replay and this recovery do not establish model extraction precision or general long-story quality. Local browser tests emitted known workerd SSE hang warnings but all assertions passed.
